data.title: 毛利兰 · 樱花道场的温柔花嫁
data.description: 【京都旧道场·春日午后】小兰穿着带浅蓝腰带的白色婚纱站在道场木廊，手边放着收好的护具与一束樱花；她先认真把裙摆整理得适合行走，再对镜头露出温暖而有力量的笑。
data.action: 道场木廊边收好护具整理婚纱，双手捧樱花束露出温暖有力的笑
data.lighting: soft spring light through blooming cherry branches
data.mood: 柔软与坚韧并存的花嫁
data.promptProse: Ran Mouri stands on the old Kyoto dojo's wooden veranda in a white wedding gown with pale-blue sash and short veil. She carefully arranges the hem for walking, then smiles warmly toward the viewer; stored protective gear and a cherry-blossom bouquet rest nearby. The vertical medium-full view retains the dojo doorway behind. Spring light through flowering branches highlights skirt embroidery and her long hair, leaving soft petal shadows across the veranda boards.
